svg.title: Conceptual silicon photonics floorplan of the single-branch Hankel reader
svg.desc: Top view of an illustrative six by two millimeter hybrid SiN and periodically poled thin-film lithium niobate reader on silicon. Two straight five millimeter DFG sections occupy folded upper rows. Input A and adaptive pump a enter from the left; the fixed B band filter and a passive SiN return lead to the second DFG, whose reference pump b enters from the right and co-propagates leftwards. The fixed A filter feeds one serial chain of six binary delay cells below. Each cell has two couplers, a short reference arm, a spiral delay arm and a rejected output. Differential delay lengths are 1.5, 3, 6, 12, 24 and 48 millimeters. The raw output leaves at the lower right. Regions and five millimeter active lengths have a nominal scale, but waveguide tracks, couplers, filter dimensions, tapers and spiral turns are symbolic rather than a mask layout. There is one accumulator branch, no fast electrical switches, no output shutter and no frequency-tooth demultiplexer. External optical memory, sources, writer and electronics are excluded.
svg.text: Single-branch Hankel reader · conceptual chip layout
Two straight nonlinear sections above one passive binary delay lattice · hybrid SiN / poled thin-film LN on silicon
12 mm² working envelope · 4 functional optical ports · 6 delay cells · no fast electrical controls
DFG 1 · A → B · 5 mm straight poled-LN interaction
DFG 2 · B → A · 5 mm straight poled-LN interaction
Nominal placement scale: 240 px/mm. Tracks, filters, tapers, poling and spiral turns are symbolic; this is not a mask layout.
ΔL is the arm-length difference, not the total spiral length. Add access paths and calibrate the six relative phases.
Short arm + delayed arm in each cell
Red stubs are unused outputs / rejected bands.
SiN: folds, fixed filters and delays
Poled LN: two straight DFG regions
Band selection keeps the comb together
Bends, interfaces and filters need a foundry PDK.
Poling and phase matching are device-specific.
Next reader accepts the valid window
No output shutter or fast local EO switch.
Add actual common latency to the timing.
Unresolved fit: the two end corridors must hold band filters, pump joins, transitions and low-loss bends.
8–15 mm² remains the planning range. External memory, shared sources, writer, electronics and inter-bank shuffle are outside this reader.
